summary: Sprint 2 Coop Récompensé (combo multipliers ×1.5/×2/×3 + CoopShareCard 'Complicité XX%') validated end-to-end. Backend: 12/12 pytest cases green covering multiplier tiers, combo break rules, best_combo persistence, solo_correct_count, total_xp cumul, and 4Q completion regression. Frontend: combo banner, feedback multiplier, combo-broken message, final CoopShareCard with all tiers/testids/buttons and WhatsApp deep link all verified via Playwright with pre-seeded challenges. No blocking issues.
critical_code_review_comments: coop_challenges.py: combo/multiplier logic is well tested and behaves as intended. Consider extracting the XP/league-update side-effect block (lines ~290-306) into a helper (award_xp_from_coop) — it duplicates gamification concerns inline and swallows all exceptions, which could mask real infra failures during silent XP loss.

CoopShareCard.jsx: navigator.share text uses literal emojis + hard-coded 'https://generaquiz.fr' URL — WhatsApp URL builder in whatsapp() duplicates the text template; consider a single buildShareText(pct, tier, p1, p2) helper to keep tier emoji + names in sync between share/whatsapp/download paths.

CoopShareCard.jsx buildBlob() uses skipFonts:true — text will fall back to system serif/sans in the exported PNG on devices where the tailwind fonts (Fraunces/Nunito) weren't inlined. Acceptable trade-off for cross-device consistency but flag if branded typography is critical for share cards.
computeComplicity fallback (solo = max(0, correct - helpsOk)) is a nice safety net for legacy documents pre-solo_correct_count field. Documented in tests via solo_correct_count checks. OK.

CoopChallengePlay.jsx FinalResults reads challenge from prop but there's no explicit refetch after the last answer — verify that challenge state is refreshed to include the completed=true + latest stats before rendering (my regression test showed the correct 4/4, best=2, so this works in practice).
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral coop challenges created during tests, all prefixed TEST_ or UI_ for identification. Reused user-provided completed token LW3cdWjTqBI (97% Complicité, best_combo=7) for the CoopShareCard tier-≥95% (Fusion Temporelle Parfaite) verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sprint 2 fully validated. Backend combo endpoint returns {combo, multiplier, base_xp, xp_earned, combo_broken} correctly; combo tiers verified: 1-2→×1.0/100XP, 3-4→×1.5/150XP, 5-6→×2.0/200XP, 7+→×3.0/300XP. help_used=true or wrong resets combo AND sets combo_broken=true if prev_combo>=3. best_combo persists in stats_coop. solo_correct_count only incremented for correct+no-help. total_xp cumulates with multipliers (7-streak = 1200 XP total). Frontend: coop-combo-banner + coop-combo-multiplier appear only when current_combo>=3; coop-feedback-mult shows 'Combo ×N' after a correct-in-combo answer; coop-feedback-combo-broken shows 'Combo perdu 💔' after a help/wrong that breaks a >=3 streak; CoopShareCard renders coop-share-visual + coop-share-complicity + 3 buttons + tier badge; WhatsApp URL uses proper emojis. In one Playwright popup the wa.me redirect to api.whatsapp.com displayed emojis as %EF%BF%BD but a direct window.open capture confirmed the JS builds the URL with correct %F0%9F%8E%89 (🎉) and %E2%9C%A8%F0%9F%A7%A1 (✨🧡) — real users get the correct emojis. No further retest needed.
